title: Figure 9: Transactional interpretation diagrams for Case 2 (two-slit transaction)
description: Three stacked color diagrams showing "Offer Waves," "Confirmation Waves" and "Completed Transaction" in the slit-imaging system, with waves passing through both slits of S2 to a combiner and circled central detector, through a "Nonlinear Crystal," and through both slits of S1 to a "Camera." The caption reads "Figure 9. Transactional Interpretation Diagrams for Case 2" and notes that the two-slit transaction forms an interference pattern at the camera. Text discusses the transactional interpretation's "two-way handshake."
